The '''Rothana experimental walker''', abbreviated '''REW''', was a [[walker]] developed by [[Rothana Heavy Engineering]] during the [[High Republic Era]]. The walker—the latest by Rothana Heavy Engineering—was displayed at the [[Republic Fair]] on the [[planet]] [[Valo]]. When [[Nihil]] [[Pirate|marauders]] [[Valo Atrocity|attacked]] the fair, a small group that included [[Supreme Chancellor|Chancellor]] [[Lina Soh]], [[Jedi Master]] [[Stellan Gios]], [[Regasa]] [[Elarec Yovet]], and several other survivors boarded the walker to evade the [[war cloud]] of [[gas]] that the Nihil dispersed across the fairground. Soh managed to [[pilot]] the walker, surprising both Gios and [[Gender|herself]]. The walker was eventually destroyed by a Nihil [[death charge]] explosive, leaving Soh severely injured and several other passengers with lesser injuries.<ref name="The Rising Storm" />
